channel.title: The Wang Report
channel.description: Independent news curation from Hong Kong: geopolitics, finance, cyber, AI, sports, science, and culture.

item.title: A lone Chinese hacker used ARTEX and Claude agents against South Korean banks
item.description: One operator, a penetration testing suite and a set of commercial AI agents were enough to disrupt the South Korean financial sector this month.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Podziemski gets $110 million from the Warriors, and the bet is on who he becomes
item.description: Golden State has priced a guard at $22 million a year before the season has asked him to prove it.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Washington frees Russian diesel for sale while Kyiv bombs the refineries that make it
item.description: Washington eased Moscow's fuel revenue and criticised Zelenskyy within a day, while Kyiv's strike campaign is aimed at those same refineries.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: 127 arrested over 3,700 per cent loans, and borrowers still need cash
item.description: The arrests are the easy part, because the people who borrowed from this syndicate still needed money and nobody else would lend it.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Employer fined for violation of safety legislation a year after worker drowned alone
item.description: The Labour Department prosecuted over a fatal accident on August 1, 2025, and the man was alone on the roof when it happened.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Four owners fined HK$116,160 for ignoring Buildings Department removal orders in Wong Tai Sin and Sham Shui Po
item.description: Most of the fines in the two rooftop cases are the daily charge for every day the owners did nothing.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: HKMA scam alert related to banks warns banks never SMS a link to do a transaction
item.description: The notice sends you to the HKMA website for the bank's own press release, so check there before you tap any link in a message.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Cluster of Influenza A cases in Kowloon Hospital went public six days after first symptoms
item.description: Symptoms began on October 2, the hospital announced on October 8, and the ward is now under close watch.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: SmartPLAY suspended 11pm to 6am on October 13 and October 15 for system maintenance
item.description: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is taking its venue booking system offline for two nights next week, and the advice is to book before or after.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Hong Kong Blockchain Development Company officer fined HK$51,000 over unpaid wages, ordered to pay HK$2.147 million
item.description: Three employees were owed about HK$1.93 million in wages and notice pay, won an award at the Labour Tribunal, and still had to wait for the company to pay.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: CHP investigates CPE carrier cluster at North Point elderly care home, three residents affected
item.description: The Centre for Health Protection found the home had not put infection control measures in place, and it is still screening for more carriers.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Trump Announces US Will Import Russian Diesel Before the Midterms
item.description: A president facing high fuel prices and an election next month has chosen cheaper diesel over a sanctions posture, and the cost of that choice is landing on Kyiv.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Lai raises Taiwan defence spending while the US answers 60 Chinese moves with one word
item.description: Washington's adjective arrived the same news cycle Taiwan logged 21 aircraft, seven warships and two official ships, and an adjective is all it came with.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Going-concern disclaimers at Hong Kong listed firms now reach SFC, AFRC and HKEX at once
item.description: A disclaimer of opinion used to be the auditor's last word on a distressed issuer, and as of 8 October it is the first line of a file held by three regulators.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: Attackers Exploit Maximum-Severity SonicWall SMA1000 Flaw Three Days After Patch
item.description: SonicWall shipped the fix on Tuesday and attackers were using the flaw by Friday, so the risk now sits in the time it takes organisations to apply a patch.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Warner's film chiefs are out under Skydance as Zaslav leaves with $606 million
item.description: Skydance closed its Warner Paramount merger on October 6, and the bill is landing on the people who stay.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Winless Buccaneers beat Cowboys 24-16 as Schottenheimer lands on the NFL's hottest seat
item.description: The Buccaneers arrived without a win, left with a 24-16 one, and the coach who hosted them is now the NFL's hottest seat.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: SonicWall SMA1000 flaw CVE-2026-102255 exploited three days after patch
item.description: A maximum-severity bug in SonicWall's remote access appliances was patched on Tuesday and under attack by Friday, which makes the weekly change window the vulnerable component.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: One Stanley developer offers six-year structural warranty and free inspections amid steel bar probe
item.description: Owners get a promise in writing and a free check, but the investigation into the steel is still open.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: FBI and Allies Seize Flax Typhoon Domains Tied to Beijing Firm
item.description: The takedown removes the scanning tools and names the company behind them, but it cannot recall the intrusions already made or the scan results already collected.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: FBI seizes seven Flax Typhoon domains behind MicroScan and FishHub hacking tools
item.description: The takedown names Beijing firm Integrity Tech as the operator, and removes the infrastructure while leaving every intrusion it already produced.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Huanggang border crossing opens Monday, and the first morning rush is the test
item.description: Both governments and Immigration have said the crossing is ready, and the first Monday morning is the first real test.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Attackers Compromise Three Country Registries and Obtain Google Certificates
item.description: Google was the target, not the weak point, and the episode shows that a domain's security can rest on a registry its owner has never assessed.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Chinese militia boat off Taiwan's east coast, where US and Japan would arrive
item.description: The vessel was found on the Pacific side of the island, the side that faces any US or Japanese reinforcement.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: Five Buss siblings sue Jeanie over a Lakers share sale she must approve
item.description: The family that has run the Lakers for decades is now a docket number, with the remaining shares as the prize.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: CK Asset to rebuild three of six starter homes blocks after two-year steelwork scandal
item.description: The developer calls knocking down half the project the most "time-saving" fix, which tells you how long the other options would have taken.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Attackers compromise .gh, .sl and a third registry, get Google certificates
item.description: Google disclosed on October 6 that the attackers sat above its domains, and every organisation with a name under those registries inherits the same exposure.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Trump's Remarks on Iran Striking Los Angeles Draw Criticism From Both Parties
item.description: The president's talk of Iranian strikes on American cities landed in a week when the war was already reaching allied soil, and objections came from his own side too.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Atlanta spent Sale's October on Philadelphia, and Yamamoto's Dodgers lead 2-1
item.description: Atlanta's ace beat Philadelphia on one day of rest and then had to face the Dodgers on the regular schedule, and the Dodgers won 3-1 to lead the NLDS 2-1.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: Dozens evacuated from Mong Kok building after rooftop fire, no cause or injuries reported
item.description: Dozens got out, and the fire danger warning is still in force today.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: British Police Arrest Seventh Man Over Iran-Linked RAF Fairford Security Incident
item.description: The Fairford case has moved from a military withdrawal to a criminal investigation on British soil, with arrests now giving the threat a human face.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: Nobody Tells You What to Eat on Day Three of the Antibiotics
item.description: A new study links sugar-rich food to deeper gut disruption during antibiotic treatment, and the coverage points to no trial of whether changing the plate helps.
item.dc:creator: Sora Whitlam

item.title: Yankees must win three straight after four errors give Tampa Bay a 5-2 Game 2 win
item.description: Tampa Bay won Game 2 5-2 without having to do anything difficult, and New York now needs three straight wins to survive.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: FBI blames a missed patch for ShinyHunters theft of staff data, names no system or flaw
item.description: The Bureau has attributed the theft of thousands of employees' personal details to a patch failure and answered by removing one person, which does nothing for the process that let it slip.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: Ukraine fires its first FP-7 ballistic missile as Kyiv says Russia holds 600
item.description: Kyiv's new FP-7 arrives the same week it puts a number on Russia's reserve, and the number is an interceptor shopping list.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: NYT Reports Iran's Guard Ordered Possible Drone Attack on Fairford Bombers
item.description: The unnamed threat behind the B-1 withdrawal now has a described form, a drone strike on a British base, which turns a vague precaution into a stated warning about Iran's reach.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: Beijing and Manila Each Accuse the Other of Breaking the Rules of the Same Piece of Sky
item.description: The Philippines calls a PLA intercept unsafe while Beijing charges Philippine aircraft with the airspace violation, and the ASEAN talks on the sea are ending with both accounts on file.
item.dc:creator: Vincent Lai

item.title: Twelve People In A Chicago Trial May No Longer Have To Be Their Own Pancreas
item.description: A University of Chicago islet cell transplant trial reports all 12 participants with type 1 diabetes potentially cured, a first small count for a disease managed by hand every day.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Pentagon Confirms B-1 Bombers Left RAF Fairford Over an Unspecified Threat
item.description: Washington has confirmed the withdrawal and named a reason without describing it, which leaves allies to judge for themselves how safe an American base abroad now is.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro now costs $3.5 per million output tokens, up from $0.79
item.description: Reflection says Beam rivals Chinese models at lower compute cost, arriving just as a major Chinese model got far more expensive.
item.dc:creator: Aya Nakamura

item.title: Chiefs reach out to Tyreek Hill after Thornton's 12 to 16 week ankle injury
item.description: Kansas City beat the Raiders 30-27 on Sunday, and the first thing the front office did with the bye week was reach for a name from the dynasty's first act.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee

item.title: South Korean banks must name their own entry point before the regulator names it
item.description: The regulator convened before anyone has publicly named how the attackers got in, which leaves every bank answering a question the commission has not yet defined.
item.dc:creator: Kai Tanner

item.title: US defence experts work inside Taiwan's military headquarters, SCMP reports
item.description: The one form of US support that needs no presidential signature has been running in the building where Taiwan plans its war.
item.dc:creator: Mei Chen

item.title: US Air Force Pulls Bombers From RAF Fairford Over Iran Plot Threat
item.description: A base central to the Iran campaign was judged too exposed to hold aircraft, so a security scare has become a limit on how the war is flown.
item.dc:creator: Maarten Bakker

item.title: HK Express Hefei flights from 3 December, HK$77 sale closed 4 October
item.description: The sale that got everyone searching closed last night, so the price you see now is not the price in the headlines.
item.dc:creator: Cheung Kwok-keung

item.title: Iran Says War Has No Military Solution as Talks Stall
item.description: Tehran says the war cannot be won by force and keeps Hormuz shut, so a conflict with no exit is now setting the pace for everything else Washington has pending.
item.dc:creator: Charmaine Lo

item.title: SFC issues Investor Identification Regime roadmap and client consent circular for exchange-traded derivatives
item.description: Two SFC circulars dated 30 September give derivatives intermediaries a build schedule and a consent procedure, and the consent half is the one that needs a client to answer.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Lam

item.title: FDA Approves Daraxonrasib For Pancreatic Cancer After Trial Shows Survival Nearly Doubled
item.description: The approval of a drug aimed at the RAS switch in this cancer gives patients a new choice, with a survival gain that is still a ratio rather than a promise.
item.dc:creator: Magnus Honeyfield

item.title: Netflix Collects Lee Chang-dong, JYP Collects The Word "Fan
item.description: One company bought a director's entire shelf while another registered the name for its audience, and both are the same kind of deal.
item.dc:creator: Joy Lee

item.title: Lamb Catches 17 Passes And The Winning Touchdown, And Dallas Keeps Houston Winless
item.description: CeeDee Lamb's 12-yard score with 40 seconds left beat the Texans 34-30, and Houston scored 30 points and still has no win.
item.dc:creator: Dev Chatterjee
